title: Beside house
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：beside　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beside 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the fisherman kept the net ① beside the fire all evening at the pier, and everybody in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the net had been left ② beside the door of the house, and nobody had asked a single question. The fisherman had come to the harbour two seasons earlier and spoke little of the harbour he had left behind him.

The logbook for July 1972 puts it plainer. It was done ③ beside herself with anger, and the boatman who kept the net had landed it ④ beside his brother at the table twice before the winter came; nothing in the harbour was ever done beside herself with anger in those days. The boatman wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ beside the grief of it, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ beside the others in the room; he was not a man who explained himself, and the harbour had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was that the net be landed ⑦ beside the wall of the yard, and that the names be written ⑧ beside the bed of the child. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried beside the wall of the yard.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she kept the net ⑨ beside the fire all evening again when nobody else would, and ⑩ beside the door of the house, she said in 1990, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the net in the same pier for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the harbour never forgot what had been done beside the door of the house.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…旁边（表时间：beside the fire all evening）
B. prep. 在…旁边（表处所：beside the door of the house）
C. prep. 与…相比（表方式／状态：beside herself with anger）
D. prep. 与…相比（引出施动者或相关的人：be landed beside his brother at the table）
E. prep. 在…旁边（表原因：beside the grief of it）
F. prep. 与…相比（表对象／目的：beside the others in the room）
G. prep. 在…旁边（表工具／材料：beside the wall of the yard）
H. prep. 与…相比（表载体／处所：written beside the bed of the child）

items.q: beside the door of the house
beside his brother at the table
beside the others in the room
beside the wall of the yard
beside the bed of the child
beside the fire all evening again
beside the door of the house, she said

answers.why: beside 意为“在…旁边”，此处引出时间 the fire all evening（守了整晚的炉火），说明那件小小的渔网是在何时留下的。
beside 意为“在…旁边”，此处引出处所 the door of the house（屋门旁边），说明东西被放在何处。
beside 意为“与…相比”，此处引出方式或状态 herself with anger（气得不能自已），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
beside 意为“与…相比”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 饭桌上的兄弟：be landed beside his brother at the table。
beside 意为“在…旁边”，此处引出原因 the grief of it（那份悲痛），说明整件事由何而起。
beside 意为“与…相比”，此处引出对象或目的 the others in the room（屋里其余的人）。
beside 意为“在…旁边”，此处引出工具或材料 the wall of the yard（院墙旁边）。
beside 意为“与…相比”，此处引出载体 the bed of the child（孩子的床边）：names written beside the bed of the child。
beside 意为“在…旁边”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的渔网，此处仍引出时间 the fire all evening。
beside 意为“在…旁边”，母亲 1990 年那句话引出的仍是那一处屋门旁边。

他说，家里从来没有人为屋里其余的人做过这件事。（beside the others in the room）
answers: In 1978 the fisherman kept the net beside the fire all evening at the pier.
The net had been left beside the door of the house, and nobody asked a single question.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 beside 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the fisherman kept the net beside the fire all evening, and nobody forgot it.
The net had been left beside the door of the house for three seasons.
The work was done beside herself with anger, as it always was in those days.
The net had been landed beside his brother at the table twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the net beside the fire all evening again when nobody else would.
The whole harbour never forgot what had been done beside the door of the house.
